description: Corrected main-store pass for Grails Gone Wild, Paper Hero's Games - Huntington Beach, B.Y.O.GAMES LLC, and Shuffle and Cut Games. fields.assessment_notes: Grails Gone Wild / GGW Cards N Collects remains a likely active TCG storefront with WPN-supported Magic activity. Fresh 2026-07-23 Wizards/EventLink confirms the existing Sunday 1:30 PM Casual Commander row and adds an August 7 Hobbit prerelease at 6:00 PM, $40, capacity 14. The official storefront route remains a Square shell in this pass, and the previously inspected Instagram remains useful for store-controlled identity and historical TCG/MTG activity through September 2025 but does not prove July 2026 social activity. Treat Grails as a lower-priority but real Sunday Commander/prerelease lead; current turnout, proxy/power norms, and direct review texture remain TBD.

fields.assessment_notes: B.Y.O.GAMES LLC remains a credible East LA gaming lounge and Magic/Commander candidate, but fresh 2026-07-23 WPN still only shows the existing Tuesday and Wednesday Commander Night rows in the checked future window. The app's 4:00 PM start-time treatment remains useful: doors/open casual, warm-ups, and free-play begin at 4 PM while the structured pod/tournament language points to 7:45 PM, four-player minimum, $10 bracket 3-4, and no infinites. No draft, prerelease/sealed, FNM, or special Magic events were found in fresh WPN. The newer official-looking byogamesela.com route was Cloudflare-blocked, so preserve it as source-health evidence, not event truth. Prior LAist/Boyle Heights Beat and review-derived texture continue to support the store as a real community third place with welcoming/space positives and bracket/no-infinites caveats.
